command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='/workspace/project/NOTES.md'
s=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
old='Tagline: "Fast" and \'simple\''
new='Tagline: \u201cFast\u201d and \u2018simple\u2019'
assert s.count(old)==1
open(p,'w',encoding='utf-8').write(s.replace(old,new))
print([hex(ord(c)) for c in open(p,encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')[2]])
print(repr(open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()))
EOF
